name: Forsaken: the Fool, alone
texts: The Fool, alone. The cards will not answer for you: jump, or don't.

name: Forsaken: Death ahead
texts: Do not pale. Death in what is to come rarely means a grave; it means a door closing behind you.

name: Forsaken: the Hanged Man now
texts: The Hanged Man in your present: this is a time to wait, not to act.

name: Forsaken: the World crowns
texts: The World crowns the cross. What you reach for is within reach.

name: Forsaken: the Tower reversed
texts: The Tower stands reversed: the blow is coming, but you may still step aside.

name: Forsaken: Death and the Tower
texts: Death and the Tower in the same reading. What falls now will not be rebuilt the same.

name: Forsaken: the Sun and the Moon
texts: The Sun and the Moon share this reading. What is hidden will come to light, if you let it.

name: Forsaken: the Fool and the World
texts: The first card and the last, the Fool and the World. One journey ends where another begins.

name: Forsaken: the Lovers and the Devil
texts: The Lovers and the Devil… be careful what, or whom, you bind yourself to.

name: Forsaken: the Tower and the Star
texts: The Tower and the Star together. Ruin, then hope; it has always gone that way.

name: Forsaken: the Magician and the High Priestess
texts: The Magician and the High Priestess: what you know and what you can do are finally speaking to each other.

name: Forsaken: the Wheel upright
texts: The Wheel turns in this reading. Luck is with you now; it will not stay forever.

name: Every card reversed
texts: Every card lies upside down. Nothing here will come to you the easy way.
All of them reversed… the cards are fighting you, or you are fighting yourself.

name: Most cards reversed
texts: Most of the cards are turned against you. Something blocks the way, and it may be your own hand.
So many reversals. Whatever you seek, you will have to wrestle it free.

name: Every card upright
texts: Every card stands upright. The way is open, for once.
No card is turned. The cards speak plainly to you today; few are so lucky.

name: Numbers rising
texts: The numbers climb from one card to the next. You are rising, whether you feel it or not.
See how the cards ascend? What began small is growing.

name: Numbers falling
texts: The numbers fall from card to card. Something is winding down; let it.
The cards descend, one after another. Something in you is coming to rest, or to an end.

name: Closing: bright
texts: The cards are kind today. Do not waste their kindness.
It is a good reading. I do not say that often.
Light outweighs the shadow here. Go gently, and go well.

name: Closing: mixed
texts: Light and shadow, both. The cards do not choose for you; that is your part.
Nothing here is written in stone. What you do next will tip the scales.
Neither blessing nor curse. A crossroads, and you are standing on it.

name: Closing: dark
texts: I will not lie to you: the cards are grim. Forewarned is forearmed.
There is a shadow over this reading. Walk carefully in the days to come.
The cards are heavy today. Heed them, and they may yet be wrong.

name: Hagalaz at the heart
texts: Hagalaz lies at the very heart. The storm is not coming; it is here.

name: Hagalaz and Isaz
texts: Hail and ice together: a hard winter, in more ways than one.

name: Sowilo and Dagaz
texts: Sowilo and Dagaz both show their faces. After the long night, the sun; few casts are this bright.

name: Fehu and Othala
texts: Fehu and Othala: what you own and where you come from are tied together. Mind both.

name: The Raven Skull and the Old Key
texts: The skull and the key. A door the dead have kept shut is about to open.

name: Nothing at the heart
texts: Nothing fell at the heart. The question itself is not yet clear to you.
The centre is bare. You have not yet asked what you truly want to know.

name: More faces down
texts: More faces turned away than shown. Much is still hidden from you.
Most of them lie face down. They keep their own counsel today.

name: Merkstave
texts: Stones lie against their grain. Something works against you.
More than one stone fell merkstave. Not everything here wishes you well.

name: Off the cloth
texts: Some rolled out of the circle; what they would have said is not for you.
Not everything stayed where it fell. Let what rolled away stay away.

name: Not one face
texts: Not one shows its face. The stones are silent today, and silence is an answer too.
They all lie face down. Ask again tomorrow; today the answer is no answer.

name: Closing (casts): bright
texts: The stones fell kindly. Do not waste their kindness.
A good cast. I do not say that often.

name: Closing (casts): mixed
texts: Light and shadow, both. What fell does not choose for you.
Nothing here is carved for ever. What you do next decides.

name: Closing (casts): dark
texts: I will not lie to you: the cast is grim. Forewarned is forearmed.
They fell heavily today. Walk carefully.
